items.briefing:
Australian organisations using JetBrains TeamCity servers should act immediately — the Australian Cyber Security Centre has confirmed these servers are being actively targeted by attackers right now. If your organisation uses TeamCity for software development or build automation, ensure it is patched and check with your IT team urgently. Separately, a banking trojan called ToxicPanda, previously focused on individuals, has matured into a threat targeting businesses, meaning staff should be extra cautious about unexpected banking or financial system prompts.

**Practical tip:** If you use TeamCity, contact your IT support today to confirm it has the latest security updates applied.

featured.title: ACSC warns of active exploitation of TeamCity servers in Australia
